title: Norml Page Types
pitch: Choose coherent page families, canonical routes and eligible intersections before making a sitemap.
problem: A list of URLs can hide unclear entity ownership or produce hundreds of near-duplicate pages.
Family/member contracts distinguish hubs, singles, categories, utilities and real relationship pages.

flow.d: Read the index and selected family contracts.
Choose include, embed, defer or omit.
Verify intersection identity and useful differences.
Record sources, routes, roles and unknowns.

commands: What page types should this site have?

items.name: Family catalog
items.desc: 33 families with linked member specifications and fit/skip rules.

items.name: Canonical relationships
items.desc: Separate navigation, route, entity and CMS hierarchy.

items.name: Intersection gates
items.desc: Evidence and maintainable unique content before page multiplication.

items.name: Extension templates
items.desc: Family/member templates with index and acceptance rules.

items.role: One flat member collection per family.

items: No CMS writes, live routes, implementation or deployment.
Does not prescribe visual tokens or block order.
Proposed, approved-planned and observed pages remain distinct.
